gate.rescaling: neighbourhood mean matched to the raw score's standard deviation
gate.selected_on: cluster-disjoint half of the training fold

fitting: cell contents are counts; the integer fan-out is one ridge-regularised closed-form solve over the table outputs on the training fold, rounded to integers; no gradient, no iteration, no test-fold selection
what_is_different_from_table_field: the columns, and nothing else. Same table topology, quantisation, fan-out cap, ridge and operating-point rule; 645 deployed wires plus 624 columns from four families measured at +0.0121 on twelve cluster-disjoint halvings of the training fold
alternate_conformer_columns_excluded: the 48 alternate-conformer and occupancy columns of the displacement family measured +0.00052 against their own control arm at +0.00052, the same number to five decimals. Carrying them would spend 384 tables on a measured zero
